product: Materialization for metric views is generally available
tagline: Materialization for metric views is now generally available.
what_it_does: Materialization for metric views is now generally available. Materialization uses materialized views to pre compute metric view results and rewrites matching queries to read from them, which accelerates queries. Materialization requires Databricks Runtime 17.3 or above.
why_it_matters: It also chooses which materialization to query for faster queries at lower cost.
